def transform(grid):
    counts = {}
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    # Count 2x2 uniform blocks
    for i in range(h - 1):
        for j in range(w - 1):
            c = grid[i][j]
            if c == 0:
                continue # Skip background
            if grid[i][j] == grid[i][j+1] == grid[i+1][j] == grid[i+1][j+1] == c:
                counts[c] = counts.get(c, 0) + 1
    
    # Find the color with exactly 2 blocks (sparse color)
    target_c = None
    for k, v in counts.items():
        if v == 2:
            target_c = k
            break

    if target_c is not None:
        # If color is Even (e.g. 6), return [[1]]
        # If color is Odd (e.g. 1), return [[0]]
        # Formula: 1 - (color % 2)
        return [[1 - (target_c % 2)]]
    
    # Fallback (if no color found with exactly 2 blocks)
    return [[1]]
